recaps.headline: Mike sets the opening bar.
recaps.story:
Mike Taylor opened with 181.10, beating Aaron Blank 181.10–105.96. Rhea Nelson edged Henry Omehe by just 1.20, while DJ Searcy’s 53.60 was the week’s low score.

Andrew Swanson scored 122.26, the week’s No. 5 score, but lost to Terrance Green. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 7–4 (excluding score ties).

recaps.headline: Craig answers back.
recaps.story:
Craig Lyons bounced back from an opening loss with the week’s best score, 145.08, and handed Terrance Green a 10.20-point defeat. Ryan Nelson and Aniwar Ibrahim were the only teams to reach 2–0.

Terrance Green scored 134.88, the week’s No. 2 score, but lost to Craig Lyons. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 10–1 (excluding score ties).

recaps.headline: Aniwar takes the spotlight.
recaps.story:
Aniwar Ibrahim led the scoring at 147.94 and joined Ryan Nelson at 3–0. Bryan Norman earned his first win by surviving Ely Ibrahim, 114.52–110.14.

Ely Ibrahim scored 110.14, the week’s No. 6 score, but lost to Bryan Norman. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 6–5 (excluding score ties).

recaps.headline: Ely erupts. Ryan stays perfect.
recaps.story:
Ely Ibrahim’s 152.78 led the league, but the standings story belonged to Ryan Nelson: a 127.24–118.12 win over Henry Omehe made Ryan the only unbeaten manager at 4–0. Aaron Blank also picked up his first win.

Henry Omehe scored 118.12, the week’s No. 5 score, but lost to Ryan Nelson. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 7–4 (excluding score ties).

recaps.headline: Rhea rises. Ryan’s streak ends.
recaps.story:
Rhea Nelson posted the week’s high score, 155.76. Aniwar Ibrahim handed Ryan Nelson his first loss, 125.56–102.00, leaving Ryan, Aniwar and Andrew Swanson tied at 4–1 by record. Mike Taylor scored 130.64 and still lost.

Mike Taylor scored 130.64, the week’s No. 5 score, but lost to Bryan Norman. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 7–4 (excluding score ties).

recaps.headline: Half a point. Full bragging rights.
recaps.story:
DJ Searcy beat Craig Lyons 93.68–93.18—the closest game of Weeks 1–6. Mike Taylor topped the scoring with 135.74. Ryan Nelson and Aniwar Ibrahim moved to 5–1, while Craig fell to 1–5.

Rhea Nelson scored 117.94, the week’s No. 3 score, but lost to Mike Taylor. Against the other 11 teams, that score would have gone 9–2 (excluding score ties).
